# Pedagogy fixtures (not official catalog entries)

Single-file Staqex programs preserved for **Spec Verification** suites after the
legacy `examples/01`–`17` tree was retired (LISS-0106 Phase 4).

Official curriculum lives under `examples/basics/` and `examples/applied/`.
These fixtures exercise Kernel surfaces (grid HO, DTQW pedagogy, gauge phase,
sparse Ising, and similar) without expanding the SV-09 allowlist.

Do not cite these paths in user-facing learning paths; link to the v2 catalog
entry that teaches the same idea where one exists.
